she had plenty of trouble finding a man she couldn't boss. ...AND PLENTY MORE AFTER SHE FOUND HIM!

Gaetano, Preside della Scuola di Castel Romito

Down This Street Raced Dead-End Violence... Down This One Stretched Excitement Taut As Silk!

At the end of an empire, a mystery began.

Marie Curie / Gertrude Stein / Countess Greffülhe / Madeleine Lemaire (voice)
Colette / Camille Claudel / Suzanne Valadon / Berthe Morisot (voice)
Sarah Bernhardt / Ana de Noailles / 'La Goulue' / Supervising mistress / Mother of a family (voice)

Nothing's sicker than love, not even The Dead

Too Young to Know...Too Reckless to Care...

The Untold Story of Mother Teresa

He suspects foul play and with the help of his friends Aajoba, Aboli, and Bhubhu, Banesh decides to investigate more about the incident. Soon, he realizes that he has walked himself into trouble as he has to face off against Appa, a cruel criminal.

Who would you choose to have sex with your wife?

Le technicien tire-fesses / Le garagiste / L'animateur concours

From this split-second on these men are going to be very rich... or very dead!
